title: auth.rs doc incorrectly says reqwest silently drops invalid headers; it returns an error
description: The AuthProvider doc comment says: 'On HTTP code paths the header value is passed as &str directly to reqwest, which silently drops headers it cannot encode rather than returning an error.' This is false. reqwest's RequestBuilder::header() stores the error internally and surfaces it as Err from .send(), which maps to ClientError::Http in fetch_session, call, and blob methods. There is no silent drop — the request fails with an error. The actual asymmetry is the error type (ClientError::Http on HTTP paths, ClientError::InvalidArgument on WS paths), not silent vs. erroring behavior. This doc misrepresentation may mislead AuthProvider implementors into thinking HTTP paths are forgiving.
